status.burn.apply.note: Fire burst flash and a short fire-magic whoosh: catching fire.

status.burn.tick.note: Three 0.45 s slices of burning coal crackle, quiet and short.

status.poison.apply.note: Acid bubbling and a designed 'poison effect' swell.

status.bleed.apply.note: Bloody blade cut and a wet blood squirt.

status.bleed.tick.note: Water drips and a small splat, short and quiet.

status.freeze.apply.note: Designed freeze FX and ice grinding/cracking.

status.freeze.tick.note: Single ice cracks sliced from one ice-cracking recording.

status.stun.apply.note: A heavy pipe bonk and a light ringing clang: a blow that rings the head.

status.stun.tick.note: A short bird chirp, a small bell and a tiny tap: soft 'stars around the head' ticks.

status.sleep.apply.note: An RPG power-down and a small gentle spell.

status.sleep.tick.note: Quiet slices of a magic-wand glitter (sleep dust).

status.confused.apply.note: Mystical wind-chime transition and an 'old timey magic' flourish.

status.dazed.apply.note: A designed tinnitus swell and a high fading ring.

status.dazed.tick.note: Soft slices of a long ringing magic-circle tone.

status.blind.apply.note: Old flash-powder burst and an invisibility spell swell.

status.slow.apply.note: A slow-down zoom effect and a pause sound.

status.slow.tick.note: Low soft whooshes (bass deep whoosh, broomstick, soft swish).

status.marked.apply.note: A bell ding and a clean ping: you have been picked out.

status.marked.tick.note: A single clean heartbeat; quiet and short.

status.barrier.apply.note: A force-field swell and a magic-shield block.

status.barrier.tick.note: Soft slices of a wind-and-water aura.

status.regen.apply.note: An RPG heal shimmer and a short heal-up.

status.sunder.apply.note: A crack-and-crunch and scrap metal crashing: armour giving way.

status.curse.apply.note: A cursed dark-magic stinger and a necromancy summoning swell.

status.curse.tick.note: Short slices of a low dark-magic loop.

status.silence.apply.note: A muffled boom and a negative spell echo: sound shut off.

status.disarm.apply.note: A sword dropped on the floor and a weapon drop.

status.root.apply.note: A wooden creak and creaking wood: roots taking hold.

status.root.tick.note: Soft leather/wood creaks (quiet source, peaks only).

status.rally.apply.note: A war horn and a cinematic hit with horns: a call to arms.

status.rally.tick.note: One soft mid tom drum hit (a marching beat).

status.haste.apply.note: A quick whoosh and a positive shimmer whoosh.

status.block.apply.note: A shield guard hit and an 'attack blocked' clang.

status.deflect.apply.note: A sword contact with swipe and a sword impact ring.

status.deflect.tick.note: Small knife cling and a light ringing clang, short.

melee.swing.note: Three short, dry melee whooshes (basic melee swing, swing woosh, stick swish).

melee.hit.note: Sword hit impact, a sword hitting a body, and a short damage thud.

melee.crit.note: Heavier: a gore impact, a boxing punch and a slash-cut.

melee.miss.note: Very short air whooshes, lighter than the swing.

death.humanoid.note: Two short male death grunts (no screams, no words).

death.beast.note: A medium monster death and a monster dying growl.

death.construct.note: Falling debris crash and a stone collapse: a golem/construct breaking apart.

loot.common.note: Plain: a canvas bag with buckles and a leather pouch.

loot.normal.note: Still plain: handling/inspecting an item and a small pickup pop.

loot.uncommon.note: A lyre-strum item pickup chime and a small magic-item ping.

loot.magic.note: A glittery glissando and an item sparkle.

loot.rare.note: Crystal twinkle and a 'fragment retrieve' shimmer.

loot.epic.note: A bell-tree magic spell and an achievement sparkle, longer and richer.

loot.legendary.note: Grand: a short holy choir ('aah') and an epic cinematic level-up whoosh.

coin.note: A money bag and a handful of coins.

equip.note: Sword unsheathe, leather armour being put on, and a belt buckle.

ui.click.note: Kept Kenney: short, clean, subtle clicks that suit a sound heard constantly.

ui.hover.note: Kept Kenney: tiny ticks, the least intrusive option.

ui.open.note: Kept Kenney: clean and short; nothing on freesound beat it for a constantly-heard sound.

ui.error.note: Kept Kenney: soft error blips; freesound buzzers are harsh/electronic.
